title: Huckabee Condemns ‘Terrorist’ Attacks on Palestinians in West Bank Town Hall
summary_full: Mike Huckabee, the U.S. ambassador to Israel, made a rare trip to meet with Palestinians after international backlash over attacks by Israeli settlers.
summary_public: Mike Huckabee, the U.S. ambassador to Israel, made a rare trip to meet with Palestinians after international backlash over attacks by Israeli settlers.
